name: Clear Overlays
summary: Makes the carved pumpkin view and the powder snow frost lighter, so you still see the world behind them.
logoPrompt: A single carved pumpkin with a glowing see-through face, light shining through it onto soft blue snow, floating on a dark background

cover.tagline: See the world behind the pumpkin.

description: **Clear Overlays lightens the two screen overlays that hide the most, so a pumpkin on your head or a step into powder snow no longer blacks out your view.**
- Wearing a carved pumpkin keeps its face shape, but the dark part covers only 40 percent of the screen instead of all of it.
- The frost of powder snow keeps its crystals at the edges, at half strength.
- Both are made from the vanilla textures, pixel for pixel: only how strongly they cover the world changes.
- The frost still fades in while you freeze, so you notice the danger in time.
Put the zip into the `resourcepacks` folder of your game, then turn it on under Options > Resource Packs. Put on a carved pumpkin or walk into powder snow.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. It only replaces two textures, so you can add or remove it at any time.
- Endermen still ignore you while you wear the pumpkin. Nothing else about the game changes.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Which overlay should get lighter next? Leave a comment.
